data.explanation: Your landlord has settled the service charges (Betriebs- und Heizkosten) for the part of 2025 you lived there. Your costs were €544.30 and you prepaid €360.00, so you owe €184.30. Transfer it by 9 October 2026 using the reference given. From 1 November 2026 your monthly prepayments go up, so total rent becomes €670.00 instead of €640.00. Update your standing order unless you use direct debit. You may raise objections (Einwendungen) within twelve months of receiving the statement, and you can inspect the receipts by appointment. A tenants' association can help if unsure.
